    *,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}

    }
    @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}

    /* ══ NAVBAR ══ */

    .nv-logo-sub{font-size:.60rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;}
    .nv-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex:1;justify-content:center;}
    .nv-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .18s ease;white-space:nowrap;}
    .nv-links a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);}

    .nv-drawer-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.6;}

    .nv-ham{

    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg)}

    @media(max-width:900px){
      .nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none!important}
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:600px){
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
      .nv-logo-sub{display:none!important}
      .nv-btn-order{padding:0 10px!important;font-size:.74rem!important;height:30px!important}
      .navbar-inner{padding:0 12px!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:380px){
      .nv-logo-name{font-size:.82rem!important}
      .nv-logo-icon{width:28px!important;height:28px!important}

      font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;

    /* ══ GLOBAL MOBILE FIXES ══ */
    @media(max-width:600px){
      /* Modal */

    /* ══ PAGE HERO ══ */
    .page-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:72px 6% 80px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;}
    .page-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:38px 38px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.6),transparent 100%);}
    .hero-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:900px;height:500px;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(123,92,255,.18) 0%,rgba(240,64,200,.11) 45%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(40px);}
    .page-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.20);color:rgba(150,225,255,.90);font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:24px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .05s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-eyebrow-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2.2s infinite;}
    .page-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .12s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-title .plain{color:var(--text);}
    .page-title .grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .page-sub{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.82;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;max-width:52ch;margin:0 auto 36px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .20s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);opacity:0;animation:up .5s .26s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb a{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;}
    .page-breadcrumb i{font-size:.65rem;opacity:.5;}

    /* ══ TRUST BAR ══ */
    .trust-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px 20px;margin-top:32px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .32s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .trust-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 15px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);}
    .trust-pill i{font-size:.75rem;}

    /* ══ APPS SECTION ══ */
    .apps-section{padding:0 6% 100px;position:relative;}
    .apps-wrap{max-width:1300px;margin:0 auto;}

    /* Section label */
    .section-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:32px;}
    .section-label-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent);}
    .section-label-line.right{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.10));}
    .section-label-text{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;}

    /* ══ APP CARDS GRID ══ */
    .apps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;margin-bottom:72px;}

    .app-card{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);

    .app-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.15s}
    .app-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.20s}
    .app-card:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.25s}
    .app-card:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.30s}
    .app-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--border-hi);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}

    /* Card header band */
    .app-card-band{
      padding:28px 24px 24px;

    }
    .app-card-band::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--band-grad,var(--grad-soft));opacity:.7;}
    .app-card-band-glow{position:absolute;top:-20%;right:-10%;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--band-color,rgba(123,92,255,.25)),transparent 65%);filter:blur(20px);pointer-events:none;animation:pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;}

    /* App icon */
    .app-icon{
      width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;
      display:grid;place-items:center;
      flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;
      box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .app-card:nth-child(2) .app-icon{animation-delay:.8s}
    .app-card:nth-child(3) .app-icon{animation-delay:1.6s}
    .app-card:nth-child(4) .app-icon{animation-delay:.4s}
    .app-card:nth-child(5) .app-icon{animation-delay:1.2s}
    .app-card:nth-child(6) .app-icon{animation-delay:2s}
    .app-icon svg,.app-icon i{font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;}

    .app-card-band-info{flex:1;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .app-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .app-tagline{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .app-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid;}

    /* Card body */
    .app-card-body{padding:20px 24px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}

    /* Info rows */
    .app-info-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
    .app-info-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);}

    .app-info-label{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px;}
    .app-info-val{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--soft);font-family:'DM Mono',monospace,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
    .copy-btn{
      width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;

      display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.72rem;flex-shrink:0;
      transition:all .2s ease;
    }
    .copy-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;}
    .copy-btn.ok{background:rgba(52,211,153,.15);color:#34d399;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.25);}

    /* Compatibility tags */
    .app-compat{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;}
    .compat-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;}
    .compat-tag i{font-size:.6rem;}

    /* Download button */
    .app-dl-btn{
      width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:var(--r-md);

      text-decoration:none;color:#fff;

      letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
      transition:all .3s ease;margin-top:auto;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .app-dl-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,0);transition:background .3s ease;}
    .app-dl-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.10);}
    .app-dl-btn:hover::after{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);}

    /* ══ DOWNLOADER GUIDE ══ */
    .guide-section{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);
      background:var(--grad-soft);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding:40px 40px 36px;
      margin-bottom:72px;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .guide-section::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5%;top:-20%;width:400px;height:400px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(64,207,255,.10),transparent 65%);filter:blur(40px);pointer-events:none;}
